status: review only: not wired into the game
source: art/nerra-v2 (model.py, render.py, post.py; Blender 5.2 bpy, Cycles CPU, AgX Punchy, transparent film)
pivotConvention: pivot = the ground point under her body (her footprint centre). Draw a frame at its natural size drawSize (units) with pivot on the villain foot point (today footX, footY=232); never rescale per frame.
collisionConvention: circles: [x, y, r] game units relative to the pivot (y down), fitted inside alpha>=128, largest first, until 93% of the solid area is covered or r < 3.0. Collision follows the drawn frame: swap circles with the frame.

walk_r.note: side-step moving screen-right; body turned 32 deg toward the travel

walk_l.note: rendered separately (not a mirror) so the key light stays top-left and the crusher stays on screen-left

turn_r.note: from the walk_r heading to facing the screen; play reversed to turn away

jump.note: jump_air is rendered 0.42 BU (about 29 units) above the ground; the pivot stays on the ground point

snap_l.note: crusher claw (screen-left); hold windup as the 1.2-1.8 s tell

gaze.note: calm face with the eyes turned: first letter u/c/d = up/centre/down, second l/c/r = screen left/centre/right (about 26 deg yaw, 20 deg pitch). Pick the cell nearest the ball direction.
